verdict.rationale: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor (SoC), and a chip has no user-facing command interface to operate with natural language, so this axis is a category error for this product type. The Copilot+ PC and on-device AI positioning (NPU TOPS, AI Hub, GenieX) shows the chip can run AI models for OEM and OS software. It does not show the chip itself is operated through natural-language commands, so the axis does not flip to applicable.
